published_reviews.title: Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: Confirmed final Vanier competition was 2024, results April 2025; no future Vanier deadline. Separate CGRS-D successor exists as private draft. Requires authorized audited archive; never automatically rename Vanier to CGRS-D.

published_reviews.title: UBC International Major Entrance Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: UBC official: C$10,000–25,000 per year for 2026/27; renewable up to 3 additional years; study-permit international first-entry undergraduate; automatic merit consideration on admission; not full tuition; 2027/28 amount unconfirmed.

published_reviews.title: McGill University Undergraduate International Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: Generic record overlaps existing published McGill Entrance Scholarship; McGill has automatic one-year and separately applied major entrance awards; foreign-school major award deadline Jan 21, admission Jan 15, year not printed on official page; C$12,000 level Canadian citizens/permanent residents only.

published_reviews.title: McGill University Masters International Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: No programme-specific evidence for a university-wide Masters International Scholarship. McGill Biomedical Engineering thesis masters minimum C$24,000/year is department-specific; non-thesis self-funded. Do not generalize or invent deadline.

published_reviews.title: McGill University Phd International Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: No programme-specific evidence for a university-wide PhD International Scholarship. McGill Biomedical Engineering PhD minimum funding is department-specific; do not generalize to all PhDs.

published_reviews.title: University of British Columbia Masters Excellence Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: Existing generic title and university home-page source do not identify a specific award. Do not treat general graduate funding as guaranteed C$18,000 plus tuition.

published_reviews.title: University of British Columbia Phd Excellence Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: Generic award identity unresolved. Cannot substantiate universal full tuition plus C$18,000 stipend without a programme-specific call.

published_reviews.title: University of Toronto Masters International Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: No verified specific award matching generic title. U of T general funding resources cannot substantiate universal full tuition plus stipend for every Masters programme.

published_reviews.title: University of Toronto Phd International Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: Generic title requires programme-specific identity; do not infer a universal independently awarded PhD international scholarship.

published_reviews.title: Columbia University Obama Foundation Scholars
published_reviews.evidence_note: Current Obama Foundation programme page describes 2026/27 University of Chicago cohort, not Columbia degree scholarship; prior Columbia cohort involved audited courses and nondegree leadership training. Requires scope and continuation review, not inference of discontinuation from absence.

published_reviews.title: Adobe Research Fellowship
published_reviews.evidence_note: Adobe India AI Research Fellowship is a distinct India-only PhD research award of INR 1,200,000; do not transfer its terms to generic Adobe Research Fellowship. Generic 2027 cycle not verified.

published_reviews.title: McGill University Entrance Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: One-year entrance awards automatic; major entrance separate application. Foreign school major scholarship Jan 21 and admission Jan 15 (official page lacks year); C$12,000 major awards Canadian/PR only. Keep separate from generic published undergraduate duplicate.

published_reviews.title: Lester B. Pearson Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: Duplicate canonical programme also listed under University of Toronto Lester B. Pearson Scholarship. For Sep 2027: school nomination Oct 9 2026, U of T admission Oct 16, scholarship submission Nov 6; high-school nomination mandatory; full tuition, books, fees, residence four years. Do not publish duplicate.

published_reviews.title: University of Toronto Lester B. Pearson Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: Same Pearson programme as ce28b2b8; deadline Nov 6 2026 only for previously nominated and admitted applicants. Nomination Oct 9 and admission Oct 16 have already passed. Authorized canonical reconciliation required.

existing_private_drafts.title: Canada Graduate Research Scholarship — Doctoral (CGRS D), 2026 competition
existing_private_drafts.evidence: C$40,000 per year for three years; SSHRC direct deadline October 19, 2026 at 20:00 ET; Canadian institutional deadline can be earlier. No universal 2027 future deadline. International applicants face enrolment and other conditions; existing draft ALL nationalities needs qualification.
